key_insight: Approximating anisotropic reflection with multiple spherical Gaussians enables analytically tractable solar radiation pressure calculations for satellite surfaces.
engineering_relevance: The formulation could support stability analysis and controller design for satellites affected by direction-dependent reflection from surfaces such as solar cells with periodic metal bars.
method: Model anisotropic reflection using the Ashikhmin–Shirley model.
Approximate anisotropy with multiple spherical Gaussians.
Exploit spherical-Gaussian product closure to derive an analytical SRP approximation.
evidence_signal: Approximation accuracy is numerically evaluated for weak and strong anisotropy; the abstract reports no quantitative error metrics.
watch_item: This is satellite radiation-pressure modeling, not AI or perovskite-cell research; accuracy beyond the two evaluated cases remains unspecified.
